name: Mini Funny Nurse Sticky Notes (15 Pads)
seoTitle: Funny Nurse Sticky Notes Gift Set for CNAs
metaDescription: A set of 15 mini medical themed sticky note pads with funny nurse designs, a cheerful budget friendly gift for CNAs, nursing students, and the whole unit.
summary: Fifteen mini sticky note pads with playful medical designs, a lighthearted gift that actually gets used at the nurses station.
whyItWorks: Nurses run on notes. Between report sheets, reminders to call pharmacy, and the running list of who needs what at 0400, a pad of sticky notes is always within arm's reach at the nurses station. A set of funny, medical themed mini pads makes that everyday habit a little more fun, and the small size slips easily into a scrub pocket or a clipboard.

With 15 pads, there is enough to keep a few and share the rest, which makes it a good pick for a CNA appreciation gift, a class of nursing students, or a box left in the break room during Nurses Week. Students in particular use sticky notes constantly to flag textbook pages and drug cards. It is budget friendly and lighthearted, so it fits a Secret Santa, a thank you for a preceptor, or a small add to a larger gift.
goodToKnow: Check the listing photos to see the designs and sayings so they fit the recipient's sense of humor.
The pads are mini sized, so they suit quick reminders more than long notes.
Pair them with a fun pen or a badge reel for a cute pocket bundle.

faq.q: Are these appropriate for a hospital setting?
faq.a: They are medical themed and playful. Look through the listing photos to make sure the jokes fit the recipient and their workplace.

faq.q: Is this a good CNA appreciation gift?
faq.a: Yes. It is small, useful, and fun, and with 15 pads it is easy to split among a team.
